original_target.title: The disk maximizes the first magnetic Neumann eigenvalue

scope_comparison: Lena–Sundqvist September paper settles magnetic-field monotonicity and deGennes bound for the disk itself, not comparison with every simply connected domain at fixed area. The shape theorem known while disk ground state is radial leaves nonradial angular-momentum branches. Disk-only conjectures are not Fournais–Helffer all-shapes.
